data.spiritual_significance: Benno, as a Christian name, carries the legacy of several revered saints, including St. Benno of Meissen, St. Benno of Palermo, and St. Benno of Osnabrück. These men dedicated their lives to the service of God and the betterment of their communities. The spiritual significance of the name Benno, therefore, signifies a life devoted to faith, service, and the pursuit of holiness.
